text: T-3553 shoreline: swap the 12 m margin for reading the water mask between cells (about 1 h)? Narrow city rivers then count as water across 69-75% of their width instead of 55-60%; shore forgiveness about the same. Pick: swap. Separately, NYC and 8 other US packs use TIGER water that is up to 116-178 m off around Brooklyn's piers; OSM water instead is about 2 h plus a water rebuild of those 9 packs, and moves track prices there. Pick: queue it for a night run.

T-3540 (landed): tram stops on single track now draw a passing loop, but the sim still runs every single-track tram stop as having none. Should the sim honour tram passing loops, as it does for rail? It would raise capacity on single tram lines in existing saves. Pick: yes.

T-3540: at a rail passing station one direction's train still stops on the inner track, which now has no platform beside it (artifacts/trainworld/t3212/t3540-meet-M-z18-light.png). Leave it, or draw a second platform when a station has a loop?
